message.content:
Here’s a mix of classics, modern hits, and hidden gems you might enjoy:

| # | Title | Year | Why it’s worth watching |
|---|-------|------|--------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** (1980) | A masterclass in dread – Stephen King meets Kubrick. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** (2018) | Intense family drama turned supernatural nightmare. |
| 3 | **Get Out** (2017) | Social satire wrapped in a chilling thriller. |
| 4 | **Midsommar** (2019) | Daylight horror that turns bright into unsettling. |
| 5 | **It Follows** (2014) | Creepy premise with a relentless, slow‑burn tension. |
| 6 | **A Quiet Place** (2018) | Silence is survival; the stakes feel real. |
| 7 | **The Babadook** (2014) | Psychological terror that stays with you after the credits roll. |
| 8 | **The Conjuring** (2013) | Paranormal investigation with solid scares. |
| 9 | **The Witch** (2015) | Slow‑burn period horror that builds dread through atmosphere. |
|10 | **Suspiria** (1977) | Visually striking, unsettling, and hauntingly musical. |

Feel free to pick based on your mood—whether you want classic dread or something fresh and unsettling!
